name: brainstorm
description: Multidisciplinary scientific panel: structure the submission (classifying its type against the bundle input-type catalog — the single reference file that defines every type, its reviewing rubric, its output shape, and its outline), assemble an expert panel, let every member work the submission in parallel in the shape the catalog maps its type to (delivering the chain of thought stepwise through the submit_step tool, assembled by the runtime), review each member chain of thought step by step (commentors, judge, bounded redevelopment), audit the reviewed outputs across fields (novelty claims, contradictions, unexplored seams), then synthesize one final summary.

panelSize.description: Maximum number of seats the deterministic panel.select activity may produce.

moduleSize.description: Number of umbrella leaves panel.select takes from each department per chunked round-robin pass.

maxAttachmentFiles.description: Ceiling on annotated attachment-inventory entries the file partition activities may emit.

steps.notes: Turn the raw submission into the structured input every downstream step reads. session.submission is the runtime-provided raw prompt plus attachment descriptors.
Deterministic orchestrator step: keep only the annotated files whose relation label is not NA. This list is the only file map any later model call receives.
Deterministic orchestrator step: the NA-labeled files as a separate audit artifact. Never bound into later model calls.
Ground and return only the three-level expertise tree (department -> umbrella -> subfields), relevance-sorted at every level. Panel seating is deliberately separate.
Provider-neutral deterministic runtime transform. The registered panel.select handler applies stable chunked round-robin selection and returns no more than panelSize seats.
Optional checkpoint before any member starts thinking. The panel may only shrink here, never grow. Unattended runtimes may auto-approve (skippable).

gate.title: Confirm the panel
gate.prompt: Review the seated panel before the brainstorm starts. Approve it as-is, or remove seats to shrink it. Seats can never be added at this gate.

actions.description: Proceed with the seated panel as shown.
Remove one or more seats, then proceed with the remaining panel.

steps.notes: First pass: every member works the submission in parallel, producing the output shape the catalog maps input.type to, a chain of thought of exactly input.cotSteps steps, and (for shapes positioned against a literature map: paper, resolution, survey) a novelty statement.
Review every member's chain of thought, one member at a time.

body.notes: Walk the member's chain step by step. The chain's LENGTH is invariant: a redevelopment replaces steps from the current one onward but never changes the step count, so this loop runs exactly input.cotSteps times.

One iteration = one review round on the current step: gather comments, judge, and redevelop if the judge did not Pass. Bounded: round 1 is the initial review and at most 3 redevelopments follow (maxIterations 4). onExhausted=proceed is the forced pass: after the last permitted round the step stands as-is and the walk advances. review.allowedVerdicts is computed by the runtime from catalog.verdicts.sequencing and this step's previous round (a Build may not immediately follow a Build).

steps.notes: Every panel member except the thinker comments on the current step, in parallel. Commentors see chain steps 1..stepIndex only — never the developed paper.
One judgement over all comments of this round.

Redevelop only when the judge did not Pass AND a redevelopment budget remains (review.round is the 1-based round counter; on the final permitted round a failing verdict is recorded and the step is force-passed by onExhausted instead).

then.notes: The runtime applies the returned revision to ideas[member.id]: chain steps before fromStep are frozen and carried verbatim, revisedSteps replace steps fromStep..end, and the paper and novelty are replaced. The next round then re-reviews the rewritten step (the loop does not advance the step walk).

steps.notes: Sequential integration audit after review: one auditor reads every member's finished output (the chains never reach it, by construction), verifies each novelty claim across fields, and maps contradictions and unexplored seams between the seats. Advisory input to the chair.
Rapporteur step. The bind projects each idea to its output and novelty statement only — the chain of thought never reaches the chair, by construction.
